features: 【⌨️ Full-Size Keyboard with Number Pad】Designed for maximum productivity with a complete full-size layout including a dedicated numeric keypad, making it ideal for office work, accounting, data entry, spreadsheets and everyday computing. Dedicated multimedia shortcut keys provide quick access to volume, media playback, email and browser functions.

【📶 Reliable 2.4GHz Wireless Connectivity】Enjoy a stable, lag-free wireless connection up to 10 meters using the compact USB nano receiver. Simply plug in the receiver for instant setup without installing drivers, delivering seamless compatibility with desktops, laptops and major operating systems.

description: Experience hassle-free productivity with the Acer OfficeMate ACR105 Wireless Keyboard & Mouse Combo, designed to deliver reliable performance for home, office and hybrid work environments. The full-size keyboard features a dedicated number pad and multimedia hotkeys, enabling faster data entry and convenient access to frequently used functions. The included ergonomic wireless mouse comes equipped with a responsive 1200 DPI optical sensor, ensuring smooth and precise cursor control across most desk surfaces. Powered by dependable 2.4GHz wireless technology, the combo provides a stable connection of up to 10 meters through a compact USB nano receiver, allowing you to enjoy a clutter-free workspace without cables. Built for everyday durability, the keyboard features a spill-resistant design with drainage channels that help protect against accidental liquid spills. Intelligent power-saving technology automatically places the keyboard and mouse into sleep mode when idle, extending battery life for uninterrupted productivity.
